section: If one shall have Children, yea or no?
anchor: long before marriage
conditions: C1: A man or woman long before marriage, or an ancient bachelor or maid, asks whether ever to have a child or children.

condition_logic.expression: C1; inspect fruitfulness of fifth-house sign OR ascending sign.

assertion: Consider whether the fifth-house sign or ascending sign is fruitful; the named fruitful signs are Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces. The question concerns having issue before death.
uncertainty: U-A01: The passage does not make fruitfulness an unambiguous indispensable gate for every following positive testimony.

section: If one shall have Children, yea or no?
anchor: shall have Children or Issue ere they dye
conditions: C1: The A001 question context applies.
C2: Ascendant lord is in conjunction, sextile, trine or square with fifth lord.
C3: Moon is in conjunction, sextile, trine or square with fifth lord.
C4: The planet to which fifth lord applies, or with which it is in aspect, is free from combustion and other accidental or essential misfortunes.

condition_logic.expression: C1 AND (C2 OR C3) AND C4, subject to unresolved fruitfulness gate U-A01.

assertion: Lilly gives this as an argument that the querent shall have children or issue before dying; ascendant lord may be in any sign.
exceptions: Lilly explicitly observes that conjunction is not properly an aspect, while including it in this list.
uncertainty: U-A01: Relationship of the preceding fruitful-sign inquiry to the operative aspect package is not made formally explicit.

section: If one shall have Children, yea or no?
anchor: a strong argument of having Issue or Children
conditions: C1: The A001 question context applies.
C2: Fifth lord is in ascendant.
C3: Moon is in fifth.
C4: Ascendant lord is in fifth.

condition_logic.expression: C1 AND (C2 OR C3 OR C4).

assertion: Any of these placements is called a strong argument of issue or children, in like manner to the preceding judgment.

section: If one shall have Children, yea or no?
anchor: but not so soone
conditions: C1: Neither ascendant lord nor Moon applies to fifth lord.
C2: There is rendering of virtue or light one to another.
C3: There is translation by or from the principal significators.
C4: There is collection by or from the principal significators.

condition_logic.expression: C1 AND (C2 OR C3 OR C4).

assertion: Issue may still be judged, but less soon than in the first manner of judgment.
uncertainty: No numerical delay or locally complete definitions of rendering, translation and collection are supplied.

section: If one shall have Children, yea or no?
anchor: it gives great hopes of issue
conditions: C1: Consider the planet receiving the disposition of the significators after the earlier testimony.
C2: It is clear from retrogradation, combustion and cadency in house.
assertion: The receiver being clear from those afflictions gives great hopes of issue.
uncertainty: A complete here-defined algorithm for choosing the receiver among possible planets is absent from this assigned span.

section: If one shall have Children, yea or no?
anchor: Lord of the fift Signe
conditions: C1: Identify the planet from which Moon separated and the planet to which Moon applies.
C2: The separation planet rules the fifth sign counted from the sign occupied by the application planet.
C3: Those two planets have an aspect to each other.
assertion: This testifies that the party shall have children or a child.
uncertainty: U-A02: Preserve the direction of the fifth-sign relation; inclusive counting and exact aspect implementation are not locally specified.

section: If one shall have Children, yea or no?
anchor: its not then likely he will have any
conditions: C1: The Moon separation/application planets in the preceding test do not aspect one another.
assertion: Lilly says that it is then unlikely the querent will have any children.
exceptions: The immediately following anonymously attributed angular-application-planet alternative is retained separately as A008.

section: If one shall have Children, yea or no?
anchor: and yet some say
conditions: C1: The above-named planets or significators are not in aspect.
C2: The planet to which Moon applies is in an angle.
assertion: Some unnamed authorities are reported as allowing that the querent may have issue despite the absence of aspect.
uncertainty: U-A03: Anonymous variant; the text does not erase the preceding adverse rule or explain a universal precedence between them.

section: If a Woman aske, whether she may conceive?
anchor: she may then conceive
conditions: C1: A married woman long without children asks if likely to conceive.
C2: Ascendant lord is in seventh.
C3: Fifth lord is in first.
C4: First lord is in fifth.
C5: Fifth lord is in seventh.
C6: Seventh lord is in fifth.
C7: Moon is with him.
C8: Good planets are in ascendant.
C9: Good planets are with fifth lord.
C10: Good planets are in any angle.

condition_logic.expression: C1 AND any of C2–C10; C7 antecedent remains unresolved.

assertion: The source lists these positive alternatives as permitting conception.
uncertainty: U-A04: The antecedent of with him is uncertain; the nearest is seventh lord, but this is not silently resolved.
With and good planets are source terms without a new local orb or exhaustive classification.

section: If a Woman aske, whether she may conceive?
anchor: will hereafter conceive
conditions: C1: No positive testimony in the preceding list concurs.
C2: Barren signs and ill planets occupy the former places.
assertion: The source judges that she is neither presently conceived nor will conceive hereafter.
uncertainty: The exact set and distribution meant by former places is not further formalized here.

section: If a Woman aske, whether she may conceive?
anchor: she may perhaps conceive
conditions: C1: Good and bad planets are mixed together in this conception inquiry.
assertion: She may perhaps conceive or have children, but the source says the children will not live.
uncertainty: The mixture predicate has no quantitative threshold in this passage; perhaps qualifies conception, not a numerical probability.

section: If a Woman aske, whether she may conceive?
anchor: she may have children
conditions: C1: Cancer, Scorpio or Pisces is in ascendant or fifth in this inquiry.

condition_logic.expression: (Cancer OR Scorpio OR Pisces) in (ascendant OR fifth).

assertion: The source permits that she may have children.

section: If a Woman aske, whether she may conceive?

conditions: C1: Leo or Virgo is in ascendant or fifth in this inquiry.
assertion: The source says she is not presently with child and will hardly be so afterwards.
uncertainty: Hardly is retained as a qualification; it is not rewritten as absolute permanent infertility.

section: If a Woman aske, whether she may conceive?

conditions: C1: Women long without children propound this conception question.
assertion: Lilly instructs checking whether their nativity originally denied children.
uncertainty: This local instruction does not specify an unconditional natal veto, priority weights, or a natal-analysis procedure.

section: At what time, or how long it may be ere she have a Childe?
anchor: if in the second house, the second yeere
conditions: C1: According to natural causes she may have a child or children.
C2: The querent desires to know approximately when.
C3: Locate fifth lord by house.

condition_logic.expression: C1 AND C2; use the source-explicit branches {house1:year1, house2:year2, house10:year3, house7:year4, house4:year5}.

assertion: The printed recipe maps fifth lord in ascendant/first to first year, second house to second year, tenth to third year, seventh to fourth year, and fourth to fifth year.
uncertainty: U-A05: The table is unusual but second house is image-verified and not emended. Other houses, exact epoch for the year count, and quantitative adjustments are not supplied here.

section: At what time, or how long it may be ere she have a Childe?
anchor: fixed Signes prolong the matter
conditions: C1: Apply the preceding time inquiry.
C2: The planet is swift in a movable sign.
C3: The sign is double-bodied.
C4: The sign is fixed.

condition_logic.expression: C1; branches C2→somewhat earlier, C3→not so soon, C4→prolonged.

assertion: Swiftness in a movable sign somewhat hastens the time; a double-bodied sign does not manifest so soon; fixed signs prolong the matter.
uncertainty: U-A05: No numerical offsets, sign-class list, or conflict-resolution formula is provided in this local recipe.

section: At what time, or how long it may be ere she have a Childe?

conditions: C1: A significator is swift in motion.
C2: It is direct.
assertion: Whatever sign it occupies, the significator hastens performance and brings accomplishment sooner when both conditions hold.
uncertainty: No numerical motion threshold or amount of acceleration is locally specified.

section: Whether the Querent shall have Children, be he Man or Woman that asketh?
anchor: is capable of getting them
conditions: C1: Fortunate planets behold ascendant.
C2: Ascendant lord is in ascendant, tenth, eleventh or fifth.

condition_logic.expression: C1 AND C2 AND C3 AND C4; antecedent of C4 unresolved.

assertion: For a man the source permits children or capacity to get them; for a woman it permits conception and says she is not naturally barren.
uncertainty: U-A06: He most immediately follows triplicity lord, but whether it qualifies that lord alone or the combined Jupiter/triplicity package is not explicit.
U-A18: Jupiter and the triplicity lord are source roles that could resolve to one physical planet; this is not automatically two independent testimonies.

section: Whether the Querent shall have Children, be he Man or Woman that asketh?

uncertainty: Good house and long time are not quantified in this local rule.

C5: Jupiter is combust.
C6: Jupiter is not fully removed from sunbeams.

condition_logic.expression: C1 AND C2 AND (C3 OR C4 OR C5 OR C6).

uncertainty: Hardly any is preserved; no numerical child count or survival rate is inferred.

section: Whether the Querent shall have Children, be he Man or Woman that asketh?

conditions: C1: Moon is unfortunate.

section: Whether the Querent shall have Children, be he Man or Woman that asketh?

assertion: This gives hopes and strong testimony of a child in a short span of time.

section: Whether the Querent shall have Children, be he Man or Woman that asketh?

section: Whether the Querent shall have Children, be he Man or Woman that asketh?

C4: It is in any of its essential dignities.
